title: audit detail task.agent_profile
description: detail of audit rows with action task.agent_profile: the rights profile of a task was assigned or cleared (target the task; ADR-090 section 1). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
